title: Identity Platform — External Access Token Claims (v1, FROZEN)
description: The stable claim contract for every externally-issued (RS256/JWKS) access token — human (Authorization Code + PKCE) and machine (Client Credentials) alike. Mirrors AuthenticatedExternalPrincipal (src/modules/resource-server/interfaces/) and docs/IDENTITY_EXTERNAL_API_CONTRACT.md §3. See docs/API_SECURITY_CONTRACT_FREEZE.md for the freeze/versioning policy this schema is governed by.

iss.description: REQUIRED. This platform's configured issuer. Verified, never merely copied.

sub.description: REQUIRED. ServiceAccount.id (principal_type=SERVICE_ACCOUNT) or security_user.id (principal_type=USER). NEVER Application.id.

aud.description: REQUIRED. Exactly ONE resource-API audience string. Never an array. Never a wildcard — FORBIDDEN, see docs/PHASE_2D_ARCHITECTURE's threat model.

client_id.description: REQUIRED. The registered Application's clientId this token was issued to.

tenant_id.description: REQUIRED. Server-validated at issuance — the ONLY authoritative tenant. A caller-supplied header claiming a different tenant must be rejected, never trusted over this claim.

scope.description: OPTIONAL. Space-delimited OAuth scopes. Absence means no scopes, never "all scopes". Never itself an IAM permission.

jti.description: REQUIRED. Unique token id — correlation/logging only, never itself a trust decision.

token_use.description: REQUIRED. Discriminates from an ID Token's token_use='id_token'. A resource server MUST reject any token whose token_use is not exactly 'access_token'.

principal_type.description: REQUIRED. The ONLY authoritative discriminator of who this token represents — NEVER inferred from the shape/format of sub.

organization_id.description: OPTIONAL, USER only. null = tenant-wide. Absent for SERVICE_ACCOUNT. Never independently supplied/overridden by a product from client input.

x-internal-claims-never-in-token: raw database row fields not listed above
